_note: Programs pick poses from poses.json by id, in order. A pose can be a plain id or an object that overrides instruction and/or hold_seconds. hold_seconds and extra_tolerance (degrees added to every joint's tolerance) apply to the whole program. An 'All poses' program with every pose is added automatically.

poses.instruction: Ask a grown-up to stay close by. Stand tall like a mountain! Face the camera, feet together, arms by your sides, and stay very still.
Be a tree! Face the camera and stand on your right leg. Press your left foot against your right leg, as high as you can, and put your hands together above your head.
Sit in an invisible chair! Stand sideways to the camera, bend your knees, push your bottom back and reach your arms up high.
Be a strong warrior! Face the camera with your feet wide apart. Bend your right knee, keep your left leg straight, and stretch your arms out like airplane wings.
Be a dog having a big stretch! Stand sideways to the camera, put your hands and feet on the floor and lift your bottom up high, like an upside-down V.
Rest like a sleepy mouse. Sideways to the camera, with the camera low: kneel, sit on your heels, put your forehead on the floor and stretch your arms forward.
